offering_description.value: Acquires raw land and develops it into finished residential lots by installing utilities, roads and other infrastructure. Sells the finished lots mainly to homebuilders, with a large share going to D.R. Horton, its majority owner.

primary_products.value: finished residential lots; developed land parcels

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, principally D.R. Horton, and other national and regional builders

end_markets.value: residential housing; single-family homebuilding; land development

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of finished single-family residential lots and some undeveloped tracts to homebuilders

value_chain_position.value: other: land developer buying raw land, entitling and developing it, selling finished lots to homebuilders

geography_served.value: US national: Growth markets across Sunbelt and other US states, including Texas, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest and West

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: residential lot development for homebuilders

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: lot sales contracts directly with homebuilders, mainly D.R. Horton

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, entitlement and environmental rules from local and state governments and stormwater requirements
